note: Made by `npm run spec` from src/manifest.js. Do not edit. See spec/consumers.md.

selectors.theme-<name>: A class for each theme. It sets every token of that theme, from its place in the theme tree, on the element and everything in it. Use one theme class on an element. The root theme, "default", is also on :root.
selectors.tm-invert: A class that shows an element, and everything in it, in the other mode. One exception: a button with tm-invert stays in the page's mode and exchanges its fill and label colors.
selectors.tm-over-media: A class for an area over photos or other rich backgrounds. See-through parts in it blur what is behind them, and text gets a halo of the page's color (text-halo). Use it only where it helps: blur costs a layer for each part.
selectors.data-tm-mode: An attribute, "light" or "dark", that forces one mode on an element and everything in it.
selectors.data-tm-contrast: An attribute, "more" or "base", on <html> or on an element with a theme class. "more" turns on the more-contrast variant for it and everything in it, and "base" turns it off. Without it, the reader's prefers-contrast: more setting decides.

action-angle.meaning: The direction of the action gradient: 180deg (the default) runs top to bottom.

action-gradient.meaning: "on" when the action color is a gradient, else "off". For a style query: @container style(--tm-action-gradient: on).

font-icon.meaning: The icon font: Material Symbols in the Sharp, Outlined (standard), or Rounded style, from icons.style. Set font-variation-settings from icon-fill and icon-weight.

icon-fill.meaning: Whether icons are filled: 1 (filled) or 0 (outlines), from icons.fill. The FILL axis of the icon font.

icon-weight.meaning: The line weight of icons, from 100 to 700, from icons.weight. The wght axis of the icon font.

bg-surface.meaning: Cards, menus, and other surfaces on the canvas.

bg-sunken.meaning: Wells, code blocks, and tracks below the canvas.

bg-field.meaning: The inside of text fields and other inputs.

fg-base.meaning: Body text and headings. Passes the text contrast on every background.

fg-base-muted.meaning: Secondary text. Passes the text contrast on every background.

fg-base-heading-lg.meaning: Headings in the lg size (h3). Lightens with softness, to the min-contrast grade for its size at softness 1.

fg-base-heading-2xl.meaning: Headings in the 2xl size (h2). Lightens with softness, to the min-contrast grade for its size at softness 1: the large-text level at 24 px and up.

fg-base-heading-3xl.meaning: Headings in the 3xl size (h1). Lightens with softness, to the min-contrast grade for its size at softness 1: the large-text level at 24 px and up.

fg-base-subtle.meaning: Placeholders and other hints. Passes the control contrast only.

border-base.meaning: Dividers and the edges of surfaces. Decoration only.

border-base-strong.meaning: The edges of fields and controls. Passes the control contrast.

border-base-field.meaning: The edges of text fields and selects. border-base-strong, receding at the top of softness to the lightest grade that passes the control contrast.

tint-base.meaning: Neutral soft fills, such as hover and selected backgrounds for menu items and list rows, and neutral tags. They show on the canvas and on surfaces.

tint-base-hover.meaning: A quiet soft fill on hover: 10 grade numbers from the tint, toward the text.

on-tint-base-hover.meaning: Text and icons on tint-base-hover: the label moved as far as the tint, so the contrast stays the same.

tint-base-active.meaning: A quiet soft fill while it is pressed: 20 grade numbers from the tint, toward the text.

on-tint-base-active.meaning: Text and icons on tint-base-active: the label moved as far as the tint, so the contrast stays the same.

fill-action.meaning: Solid fills that you act on, such as primary buttons, checked boxes, and switches.

fill-action-hover.meaning: An action fill on hover: 5 grade numbers lighter, in both modes.

on-fill-action-hover.meaning: Text and icons on fill-action-hover: the label moved as far as the fill, so the contrast stays the same.

fill-action-active.meaning: An action fill while it is pressed: 5 grade numbers darker, in both modes.

on-fill-action-active.meaning: Text and icons on fill-action-active: the label moved as far as the fill, so the contrast stays the same.

tint-action.meaning: Soft fills that you act on, or that show a state: soft buttons, selected rows, badges.

tint-action-hover.meaning: An action tint on hover: 10 grade numbers from the tint, toward the text.

on-tint-action-hover.meaning: Text and icons on tint-action-hover: the label moved as far as the tint, so the contrast stays the same.

tint-action-active.meaning: An action tint while it is pressed: 20 grade numbers from the tint, toward the text.

on-tint-action-active.meaning: Text and icons on tint-action-active: the label moved as far as the tint, so the contrast stays the same.

fill-quiet.meaning: The quiet button: a solid button with the polarity flipped, in the base color. Light in light mode and dark in dark mode.

on-fill-quiet.meaning: The label of the quiet button: the text color where it passes on fill-quiet, else the nearest base grade that does.

fill-quiet-hover.meaning: The quiet button on hover: 5 grade numbers lighter, in both modes.

on-fill-quiet-hover.meaning: The label of the quiet button on hover: moved as far as the fill.

fill-quiet-active.meaning: The quiet button while it is pressed: 5 grade numbers darker, in both modes. Also its edge.

on-fill-quiet-active.meaning: The label of the quiet button while it is pressed: moved as far as the fill.

fg-action.meaning: Links, and other text that you act on. Passes the text contrast on every background.

border-action.meaning: The edges of parts that you act on, such as outline buttons. Passes the control contrast.

border-focus.meaning: Focus rings. The same as border-action.

fill-action-from.meaning: The start of the action gradient on fill-action: the same grade from the start color's ramp. fill-action without a gradient. Each fill and tint state has -from and -to.

fill-action-to.meaning: The end of the action gradient on fill-action: the same grade from the end color's ramp. fill-action without a gradient.

fill-action-exact.meaning: The exact button: the darker of the key color and its partner (white or black, from the action ramp) in light mode, and the lighter in dark mode.

on-fill-action-exact.meaning: The label of the exact button: the other color of the pair. Not a guaranteed pair: the audit warns where it fails.

fill-action-exact-hover.meaning: The exact button on hover: the nearest grade at least 5 grade numbers lighter than its resting fill. A white fill, which cannot get lighter, stays white, and only its label gets lighter.

on-fill-action-exact-hover.meaning: The label of the exact button on hover: moved as far as the fill.

fill-action-exact-active.meaning: The exact button while it is pressed: the nearest grade at least 5 grade numbers darker than its resting fill. A black fill, which cannot get darker, stays black, and only its label gets darker.

on-fill-action-exact-active.meaning: The label of the exact button while it is pressed: moved as far as the fill.

border-action-exact.meaning: The edge of the exact button: the key color.

fill-action-image.meaning: The action gradient on fill-action, opaque: linear-gradient(action-angle in oklch, fill-action-from, fill-action-to). Each fill and tint state has an -image.

shine-image.meaning: The shine gradient, built on each element from the four colors it sets: --tm-shine-rim, --tm-shine-top, --tm-shine-shadow, and --tm-shine-bottom, usually the gloss grades of its state. Its opacity is --tm-shininess times --tm-shine-strength (1 by default). The colors are registered with @property, so a change of state animates.

tm-look-fill.summary: A solid action fill, with the theme's shine and lift: a primary button.

tm-look-tint.summary: A soft tint of the action color: a secondary button, or a selected item.

tm-look-quiet.summary: A quiet fill in the base color, for parts that are not the main action.

tm-look-outline.summary: An edge in the action color, with a tint on hover. In a gradient theme, the edge is the gradient.

tm-look-ghost.summary: Action text with no edge, and a tint on hover.

tm-look-surface.summary: A card or a panel: the panel color, edge, radius, elevation, and frost.

tm-look-field.summary: A text field: the field color, edge, radius, and inset shadow.

tm-look-gradient-text.summary: Action text, such as a link. In a gradient theme, the letters wear the gradient.

tm-look-ring.summary: An edge in the action color. In a gradient theme, the edge is the gradient, and follows rounded corners.

tm-enter-pop.summary: Motion: the part pops in place as it appears, and shrinks away as it goes, such as a menu or a popover.

tm-enter-arrive.summary: Motion: the part comes in from below the edge with a spring, and drops away as it goes, such as a toast.

tm-enter-fade.summary: Motion: the part fades in and out in place, such as a tooltip.
